div.head: Af 5.3
div.ab: Gif he sylf his wæpna his gefán utræcan wille, gehealdon hi hine XXX nihta ⁊ hi hine his magum gebodie.
Gif he self his wæpno his gefan utræcan wille, gehealden hi hine XXX nihta ⁊ hie hine his mægum gebodien.
Gyf he sylf his wæpno his gefán utrǽcan [wylle], gehealdan hi hine ðrittig nihta, ⁊ hi hine his magum gebeoden.
Si inimicis suis arma sua reddiderit et se dederit, seruetur XXX noctibus et parentibus et amicis suis interim offeratur.
Gif he self his wæpno his gefan utræcan wille, gehealden hi hine XXX nihta ⁊ hie hine his mægum gebodien.
If he himself is willing to hand over his weapons to his foes, let them hold him for 30 nights and let them announce this to his kinsmen.
If he himself is willing to hand over his weapons to his enemies, they shall hold him in their power for thirty days; and they shall send formal notice of his position to his kinsmen.
If he himself will hand out his weapons to his foes, they are to keep him for 30 days, and send notice about him to his kinsmen.
Wenn er selbst seine Waffen seinen Verfolgern hinausreichen will, so sollen sie ihn 30 Nächte bewahren und ihn seinen Verwandten anzeigen.
If he himself wishes to hand out his weapons to his pursuers, let them keep him 30 nights and notify his kinsmen of him.
